title: BeanL1RecieverFacet caps migrated L1 Beans at EXTERNAL_L1_BEANS = 0, so every L2 mint reverts after the user's L1 Beans are already burned (permanent cross-chain fund loss)
description: The L1->L2 Bean migration is a burn-then-mint cross-chain flow: BeanL2MigrationFacet.migrateL2Beans() calls C.bean().burnFrom(msg.sender, amount) on L1 and then relays a cross-chain message to BeanL1RecieverFacet.recieveL1Beans(reciever, amount) on L2. On L2, recieveL1Beans does `s.sys.migration.migratedL1Beans += amount;` then `require(EXTERNAL_L1_BEANS >= s.sys.migration.migratedL1Beans, ...)` before `C.bean().mint(reciever, amount)`. EXTERNAL_L1_BEANS is a hardcoded constant equal to 0. For any amount > 0 the post-increment value of migratedL1Beans is positive, so the require evaluates `0 >= positive` = false and reverts. The L1 burn has already executed and is not rolled back on L2 (separate chains, asynchronous message). Therefore every honest external Bean migrant loses their L1 Beans with no corresponding L2 issuance.
impact: Direct, permanent loss of all externally-held L1 Beans that attempt migration: L1 burn succeeds, the corresponding L2 mint always reverts because the migration cap is 0. No attacker is required; the migration path is fully bricked and every user who uses it loses funds. Critical under Immunefi v2.2 (permanent loss of user funds).

ite.intent: Re-issue externally-held L1 Beans on L2 up to the migratable supply
ite.technique: Migration cap constant left at 0 placeholder makes the post-increment require always fail
ite.evasion: No attacker; the bug self-triggers for every legitimate migrant because the L1 burn precedes and is independent of the always-reverting L2 mint

ice_chain.corrupted_state: control flow: require(0 >= migratedL1Beans) always reverts; user's L1 Beans already burned via burnFrom
ice_chain.impact: Burned L1 Beans with no L2 issuance -> direct, permanent fund loss and a fully DoS'd external migration path
ice_chain.exploit_path: migrateL2Beans burns on L1 -> bridge relays recieveL1Beans on L2 -> migratedL1Beans += amount -> require(0 >= amount) reverts -> mint never executes
